reply.text:
That's one I won't help with. I don't give doses for SARMs or any drug, and a stack for bulking is a question for a doctor, who can tell you what's actually safe for you. SARMs are unapproved and carry real risks, which is why that conversation belongs in a doctor's office, not a gym chat.

The training side I'm glad to build with you. If you want to put on size, tell me how many days a week you can train and for how long, and I'll set up a muscle-gain block. Eating enough and progressing your lifts steadily will do most of the work.
